description: This file defines client-side query functions for the ERPNext web application, including setup and filtering of queries related to users, leads, customers, suppliers, items, warehouses, and address/contact data.

methods.name: user
methods.description: Returns the query string for fetching user data.

methods.name: lead
methods.description: Returns the query string for fetching lead data.

methods.name: customer
methods.description: Returns the query string for fetching customer data.

methods.name: supplier
methods.description: Returns the query string for fetching supplier data.

methods.name: item
methods.description: Returns the query with optional filters for fetching item data.

methods.name: bom
methods.description: Returns the query string for fetching Bill of Materials data.

methods.name: task
methods.description: Returns the query string for fetching task data.

methods.name: customer_filter
methods.description: Generates filters for customer based on document data.

methods.name: contact_query
methods.description: Returns contact query with filters based on dynamic link.

methods.name: address_query
methods.description: Returns address query with filters based on dynamic link.

methods.name: company_address_query
methods.description: Returns address query filtered for the company's address.

methods.name: supplier_filter
methods.description: Generates filters for supplier based on document data.

methods.name: lead_filter
methods.description: Generates filters for lead based on document data.

methods.name: not_a_group_filter
methods.description: Returns filter to exclude group entries.

methods.name: employee
methods.description: Returns the query string for fetching employee data.

methods.name: warehouse
methods.description: Returns warehouse filters based on company and group status.

methods.name: get_filtered_dimensions
methods.description: Returns query filters for dimensions based on document fields and company.
